instructions:
Sheet for **Way of the Demon Slayer**, a PARAGON playset by Agent Fintcher for John Harper and Sean Nittner's AGON. Rules: [itch.io](https://agent-fintcher.itch.io/way-of-the-demon-slayer-a-paragon-playset). A copy of AGON is required to play.

* Use the **Slayer / Demon** switch at top right to pick a hero sheet or a GM strife roller for a demon.
* Rolls use no pop-up prompts. Set the **Roll Options** under the Ways (Obstacle, Style, Extra Way, Other dice, Spend Spirit), then click a **Way** to roll: Sword die + Style die (if chosen) + the Way's die + any extra Way and other dice, keep the highest two, then add Spirit (d4, keep highest). Extra Way, Other dice and Spend Spirit reset after each roll; the chat card reminds you which Body or Spirit to mark.
* Marking the 80 / 120 / 240 milestones on the Sword track sets your Sword die to d8 / d10 / d12.
* Breathing Techniques that change rolls (second Style, two dice for an extra Way, 2d4 Spirit, sixth Body box) update the sheet automatically.
* The Sin track shows the demon's wrath die (d6 to d12); enter it in the Wrath Die field on the Demon sheet, choose the Way being opposed, and click **Roll Strife**.

Roll logic adapted from the official AGON sheet by Jakob Oesinghaus, Miguel Peres and Tim Denee (MIT License).
